label: D1 after a rewarded trial, late in the episode (ramps toward episode end)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and essentially only when the reward input is 1 (99.7% of activation mass), i.e. right after a rewarded trial. Among rewarded D1 steps it is strongly gated by episode position: 79% of mass falls in episode trials 90-99 and 13% in 80-89, with only small activations earlier. Its magnitude grows with ep_trial, and the top activations are on the last trial(s) of the episode. It goes with low model value (82% of mass is in the lowest value bin, where value drops as the episode horizon nears), but ep_trial predicts it better than value does (value<5.22 F1 0.73; value<6.5 F1 0.68). The predicate D1 & prev reward & ep_trial>=85 gives dev F1 0.76 and mass recall 0.89; cutoffs 83 or 87 do about the same. Misses are weak activations on rewarded D1 earlier in the episode, often after runs of rewards. False positives are rewarded D1 steps around trials 85-87 where the ramp has not started yet. It does not fire on unrewarded D1, and choice, state, transition and good state barely change it (a2/rare-previous are slightly enriched). Reading: a reward-input gate that depends on the episode clock. Only observed variables are used.
